_comment: QUARANTINED legacy MCP server (issue #62). Not part of the pyecsdwan
product: it wraps the vendored pyedgeconnect reference SDK, not
pyecsdwan, so nothing it does is transactional — no plan, no journal,
It refuses to start without ECSDWAN_MCP_LEGACY_ENABLE=1. Enabled, it
exposes read-only Orchestrator tools. Direct-to-appliance tools are
removed entirely (#10). Write tools additionally require
Credentials are NEVER passed as tool arguments. Set ECSDWAN_API_KEY
here, or leave it unset and store the key in the OS keyring (service
'pyecsdwan', username = the Orchestrator host), which keeps it out of
this file entirely. There is no username/password path: that would mean
accepting a password as a tool argument.
TLS verification is on. ECSDWAN_MCP_LEGACY_INSECURE=1 disables it and is
for a lab you own, never for production.
